system.description:
You fold dense overlapping layers of chakra enhanced paper around your body, covering you like an extra layer of muscle, enhancing your speed and strength to match your refined chakra control. While your Paper Veil is active, you gain the benefits of the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.

Muscle Weave. Your strikes are controlled via your chakra controlling your paper covered form.

You can benefit from a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu stance, while in this stance.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and a rank of Mastery to your [Unarmed Damage] rolls. This increases to two ranks at 11th level.

Unarmed attacks you make can use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility while in this stance to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage].

If do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.

Craft I: You gain the Spiral Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.

Spiral Weave. Make melee attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature within 15 feet of you, as you turn your paper into a large spiraling drill, tearing into whoever is in its way. On a hit, you deal 5d6 piercing damage and force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Staggered on a failure.

Craft II: You gain the Execution Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance You cannot use this ability if you’ve used Spiral Weave this turn, and if you use this ability, you cannot use Spiral Weave, in the same turn.

Execution Weave. For all creatures in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw, as you turn your paper into a compressed spiraling spear, tearing through everything in its way. On a failure, affected creatures take 5d6 piercing damage are Staggered and Dazed, or half as much damage on a success.
